falsification_conditions: NO_SIGNALLING_FAIL invalidates a standard Bell-nonlocal interpretation
SETTING_INDEPENDENCE_FAIL means measurement independence is not preserved
S<=2 or CI overlapping 2 means CHSH violation is not detected
matched local controls exceeding the bound robustly indicates implementation leakage or scoreboard failure

construction.preferred_product: sign of chain-order displacement between setting token pairs
construction.product_distribution: P(Q=q | a,b,lambda) = exp(-beta*C(q,a,b,lambda)) / sum_{r in {-1,+1}} exp(-beta*C(r,a,b,lambda))

name: B3_PRECOMMITMENT_CONTRACT

non_factorizability_statement.factorization_failure_mechanism: outcome-product coupling under joint closure cost
non_factorizability_statement.statement: For nonzero closure_strength, P(A,B | a,b,lambda) generally differs from P(A | a,lambda)P(B | b,lambda) because the product Q=A*B is sampled from one joint distribution.

observable_consequences_predeclared.control_separation: invalid leakage and post-selection controls must still be detected
observable_consequences_predeclared.marginal_behavior: Alice and Bob marginals expected near zero by symmetric local registration
observable_consequences_predeclared.no_signalling_behavior: expected to pass finite-sample tolerance if implementation has no parameter leakage
observable_consequences_predeclared.predicted_chsh_range: unknown before execution; candidate can return S<=2
observable_consequences_predeclared.seed_stability: reported across predeclared seeds; no seed retuning

prohibited_shortcuts: no hidden remote-setting access in B1/B2 local paths

scope.design_choice: Use frozen Phase 18 source rows and setting-token chain-order displacements to define a joint outcome-product cost.
scope.heuristic: The cost is a HAOS-native engineering candidate, not a physical law and not a derivation of quantum mechanics.
scope.implemented_fact: This contract authorizes one explicit B3 joint-closure-cost candidate before execution.
scope.unverified_hypothesis: The candidate may or may not produce Bell-nonlocal correlations; no positive result is assumed.

trial_policy.scoreboard_blinding: B3 outcomes are generated before CHSH classification and without reading the frozen quantum reference table.
